skill_defects: references/method.md 'Step 6b — Major fund determination' says 'a size threshold test ... both within the fund category and across the government' but never states the thresholds (10% / 5%), while SKILL.md 'Rules that never bend' says 'Never states a current standard from memory as settled.' A run must either supply the percentages from memory or skip the arithmetic the step calls '[auto]'.

references/method.md 'Step 5 — Build government-wide statements' requires 'every item quantified and sourced ... with no unexplained residual' but gives no upload-path rule for when known reconciling items (pension deferred outflows/inflows, accrued interest) are simply not supplied: whether to present a partial net position or stop.

references/method.md 'Step 6 — Special items' (Pensions and OPEB) does not address splitting the net pension liability between governmental and business-type activities, which the government-wide statements need whenever an enterprise fund exists.

SKILL.md upload checklist has no row for post-year-end collections of receivables, although references/method.md 'Step 2' says the availability test 'can be measured' from receipts after year-end; on the upload path it can never run unless the user is asked for them.
sample_defects: township_trial_balance_by_fund.csv holds balance sheet accounts only (10 rows, no revenue or expenditure lines), so no operating statement, Statement of Activities, net-change reconciliation, or revenue/expenditure major-fund test can be built. The key does not expect them, but the file is described as a 'trial balance'.

General fund carries property tax receivable 140,000 with no post-year-end collection data, so the availability test cannot run; if none were available, unassigned would be 865,000 - 200,000 - 50,000 - 140,000 = 475,000, not the key's implied remainder of 615,000.

township_notes.md gives the net pension liability 640,000 with no deferred outflows or inflows of resources and no governmental/Water split, so the government-wide bridge (1,175,000 + 3,100,000 - 900,000 - 640,000 = 2,735,000) is necessarily incomplete.
township_trial_balance_by_fund.csv names no government, period or currency; they can only be user-asserted.
